profile_text.body:
Genpact LTD is a for-profit public company headquartered in Hamilton, D0, with ticker G and SEC CIK 0001398659. Its listed website is https://www.generali.com/, which presents content for Assicurazioni Generali Group rather than for Genpact.

The site text describes Generali Group's corporate website as offering storytelling on topics of general interest, information about activities, financial data, news, CSR, career opportunities, and history. It also mentions a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence" that the site says will enhance excellence across customer relationships, the Group operating model, and core capabilities.
